Zeevi Gut, Limma 

```{r,fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
source("plotting_functions.R")

#filenames for results data
sim_name = "zeevi_gut_medium"

tests = c(
  "limma_original_TMM",
  "limma_trend",
  "limma_voom",
  "limma_original_RLE",
  "limma_trend_RLE",
  "limma_voom_RLE",
  "limma_original_TMMwsp",
  "limma_trend_TMMwsp",
  "limma_voom_TMMwsp"
)

# sim_metrics = get_sim_tests(sim_name,tests)

subsets = c(12,24,50,100,200,400,800) #zeevi gut

generate_linegraphs_by_effect(sim_name, tests, subsets,grouping="limma")

```

```{r,fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
generate_linegraphs_by_subset(sim_name, tests,grouping="limma")
```



```{r,fig.width = 30, fig.height = 30}
generate_heatmaps_by_test(sim_name, tests, subsets)

```
